command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write sudoers.d drop-in =="
sudo -n tee /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging >/dev/null <<'EOF'
Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
Defaults log_year
Defaults !syslog
EOF
sudo -n chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging

echo "== STEP 2: validate sudoers syntax =="
sudo -n visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/99-command-logging
sudo -n visudo -c

echo "== STEP 3: pre-create log file with safe perms =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chown root:root /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo -n chmod 0600 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
ls -l /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== STEP 4: generate a test sudo command as the invoking user =="
whoami
sudo -n id
sudo -n whoami

echo "== STEP 5: verify entry landed in dedicated log with user+timestamp =="
sudo -n tail -n 5 /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== STEP 6: verify NOT written to general system log =="
sudo -n grep -c 'sudo-commands\|COMMAND=/usr/bin/whoami' /var/log/syslog 2>/dev/null || echo "0 (no match in syslog, as expected)"
sudo -n tail -n 5 /var/log/auth.log || true
